function: Channel estimation of a massive MIMO link from one-bit quantized pilot observations, recovering the spatial-domain channel matrix (p. 2-3).
system: Point-to-point hybrid-precoding massive MIMO, Nt=64 transmit antennas, Nr=16 receive antennas, one-bit ADCs, ULA with λ/2 spacing, 6 GHz carrier; no RIS (p. 2, p. 4).
method: Deep-unfolded RLAMP (N_L=5 layers) fed by DnCNN plus fully connected quantization-correction net; supervised MSE then joint NMSE training, Adam, batch 100 (p. 3-4).
data_channel: Simulated CDL-D MIMO channels per 3GPP TR 38.901, 6 GHz, 300 ns delay spread; 16000 training, 2000 validation, 2000 test samples (p. 4).
test_conditions: Same CDL-D channels, held-out test set; SNR 0-30 dB at 19 pilots (Fig. 3) and pilot count at 20 dB (Fig. 4) tested; training SNR unstated (p. 4-5).
baselines: Non-learned: OMP [2], EM-GM-AMP [3], 1bMM-ML [18]; learned: LAMP [14], CNN [6], WGAN-GP [9], CGAN [11] (p. 4-5, Figs. 3-4).
metrics: NMSE versus SNR (Fig. 3) and versus fraction of pilots (Fig. 4); about 60% pilot saving at SNR 20 dB (p. 1, p. 5).
complexity: Online order O(Nr Nt Ns Np NL) overall, with per-module orders for DnCNN and fully connected layers; similar to EM-GM-AMP and LAMP; no runtime (p. 4).
q1_support: p. 4: "Realizations of clustered delay line-D (CDL-D) MIMO channels are produced in accordance with 3GPP TR 38.901."
q2_support: p. 4: "The sizes of training, validation, and testing data sets are 16000, 2000, and 2000, respectively" is a held-out split of the same CDL-D data; p. 5: "In Fig. 4, we evaluate the performance with fewer pilots." is a pilot-count sweep, with no statement that a trained network meets an unseen scenario, band, or pilot count.
q3_support: p. 4: "the regular LAMP [14] and two CS-based channel estimation approaches" (OMP, EM-GM-AMP) and "the regular CNN-based approach [6] and two GAN models"; p. 5: "the CGAN model, the WGAN-GP model, and the LAMP can only achieve NMSE", so all are compared on NMSE.
q4_support: p. 4: "The complexity in online deployment of the dual-driven estimator mainly consists of three parts"; section IV-C gives the order of each part and the overall order O(Nr Nt Ns Np NL).
q5_support: p. 4: "Realizations of clustered delay line-D (CDL-D) MIMO channels are produced in accordance with 3GPP TR 38.901." is simulated data, and no link or DOI for code or data appears anywhere in the letter (p. 1-5), no public dataset.
notes: Included as area 2 (channel estimation with one-bit ADCs); deep unfolding with trained parameters (RLAMP) plus a data-driven correction network. q1 met by the 3GPP TR 38.901 CDL-D statement on p. 4. q2 is 0 because no unseen condition is stated; the parameter matrix beta_n has the size of the measurement matrix (p. 3), so the Fig. 4 pilot sweep probably needs retraining, which the letter does not say. LAMP [14] is an earlier arXiv paper of the same group, used as learned baseline. Fig. 3 and Fig. 4 legends read from the image of p. 5. Title and DOI on p. 1 match the work.
